about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos and clips run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); post is one of the next nine at 1080 by 1350, where type keeps a 96 px margin so the grid's 4:5 crop and the feed's rounded corners never touch it.
